blocker_resolution.conclusion: FCLR-014 is BLOCKED-ON-DESIGN, not blocked-on-data. The cache DOES hold complete 5-symbol mark+funding months, but every untested complete month lacks a complete funded 30-day train window, and no contiguous untested run reaches MIN_DESIGN_DAYS. Under the FULL C2 rule (mark+index+premium+funding) there are 0 available disjoint blocks; under the mark+funding-only rule there are 2 (2024-12, 2025-01) - still <3. A confirmatory >=3-block FCLR-014 design cannot be frozen from local data without consuming a sealed window; do NOT re-score and do NOT relax the completeness rule.
